messages.subject: Project Ironvale - funds flow and completion
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Ahead of completion on Friday 12 December, the completion statement and funds flow are now agreed with Hargrove and Marlow Tax. Buyer's total funds requirement is c.£43.32m, comprising £39.2m cash to the Sellers, £2.0m to escrow, £1.3m to repay Northbank, plus stamp duty (£196k), W&I premium and fees. Sources: £28m Northbank facility + £15.32m Crestview equity. Please arrange the equity to be with us by Thursday close.

Elena

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
